subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Get ready for… (Pre A1 Starters) + Unit 1 sounds review
outcomes: I can listen and find the right family picture.
I can write s, a, t, p, n when I hear the sounds.
I can write tap, nap, pan and pat.

tf.s: Sing and sun start with the same letter.
Pie and pen start with the letter p.
tf.why: Great! p, p, pie and pen.

tf.s: Tree and nose start with the same sound.
Mum and dad are friends, not family.
We can say: She's my sister.
tf.why: Yes! She is for a girl.
Mum is a woman, so we say She's my mum.

tf.s: The word pan starts with n.
We say Hello, Tom! to greet Tom the cat.
Ant starts with the letter n.

boxes.q: Who's this? (a boy in your family)
boxes.why: A boy in your family is your brother.

boxes.q: Which word is for a girl?
boxes.why: We say she for a girl.

boxes.q: Which word is for a boy?
boxes.why: We say he for a boy.

boxes.q: Sun and sing: same first letter?

hunt.q: Catch the word: n – a – p
Catch the word: p – a – t
Catch the word that starts like sun.
Catch the word that starts like tree.
Catch the word that starts like nose.
Catch the woman in the family.
Catch the man in the family.

mcq.why: Unit 1 sounds: s, a, t, p, n.

mcq.q: Which word is a family word?
Which letter starts the word apple?
Listen: "This is my sister." Which picture do you tick?
Order the letters: p, a, t → ?
The teacher points to Fatma: Who's this? You say …
"She's my sister." Why are mum and dad pictures wrong?
mcq.why: Only the sister picture is right.

mcq.q: Which two pictures start with the same letter?
mcq.why: Sing and sun both start with s.

mcq.q: Tap, nap, pan, pat. What sound is in the middle of all of them?
mcq.why: All of them have a in the middle.
